title: Cross-cloud store channel launch synchronization and post-launch verification
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate and execute synchronized updates to our AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplace/app store listings for the 2026.03 release. This ticket covers pre-submission checklist convergence (artifacts, legal/cert requirements, localized assets), staging and feature-flagged rollout windows per cloud, and a 72-hour post-launch verification runbook for critical signals (listing approval, purchase flow sanity, initial telemetry). Goal: minimize cross-cloud drift and provide a single source of truth for launch owners and GTM stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: All three cloud listings (AWS/Azure/GCP) submitted with identical product descriptions, pricing tier mapping, and localized assets for en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP
Signed marketplace contracts and EULA version pinned and available in /confluence/marketplace/legal/2026-03
Feature-flagged entitlement configured so we can open each cloud channel independently without code changes
Post-launch verification runbook executed within 72 hours and a launch retro doc created with action items
Monitoring: marketplace order success rate >= 98% and first-week API latency P95 within expected SLOs for Dedicated customers

GTM enablement: publish one-pager, support triage doc, and sales playbook

risks_mitigation: Azure paperwork delay: mitigate by pre-authorizing alternative time window and providing GTM reactive messaging templates
Listing copy divergence: lock canonical copy in Confluence and export snapshot to each vendor console to prevent drift
Purchase flow breakage: run nightly smoke tests against sandbox marketplaces and block rollout on critical failures
Localization errors: ship core en-US first behind feature flag while we finalize translations to avoid blocking all channels
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pre-submit) - by 2026-03-04: Complete legal packet, finalize assets, feature-flag gating validated
Phase 1 - GCP soft-launch 2026-03-06 09:00 UTC (open to 10% of accounts) - monitor 12 hour metrics
Phase 2 - AWS launch 2026-03-07 08:00 UTC (conditional on GCP success) - open to all if no blocking issues
Phase 3 - Azure launch 2026-03-09 09:00 UTC (subject to paperwork approval) - staged to US regions first
Rollback trigger: any marketplace order success rate < 95% for 1 hour or payment reconciliation issues reported
Post-launch verification: 72-hour runbook to validate order flows, licensing entitlements, telemetry integrity, and support triage response times
